metadata.document: Feedback on the Draft Auckland Unitary Plan

cleaned_body_text: Feedback on the Draft Auckland Unitary Plan. TO: Auckland Unitary Plan Feedback Team, Auckland Council, Freepost 237170, Private Bag 92300, Auckland 1142. FROM: Environmental Defence Society Inc, PO Box 91736, Victoria St West, Auckland 1142, kate@eds.org.nz. 1. INTRODUCTION. 1.1 The Environmental Defence Society (“EDS”) welcomes the opportunity to comment on the Draft Auckland Unitary Plan (“the Draft Plan”). 1.2 EDS is a not-for-profit national environmental advocacy group established in 1971. 2. LEGAL FRAMEWORK. The key environmental provisions with which the Unitary Plan must comply are set out below, focusing on the extent to which the Draft Plan is consistent with Part 2 of the RMA, the Resource Management Reform Bill 2012, the New Zealand Coastal Policy Statement 2010, the Hauraki Gulf Marine Park Act 2000, the National Policy Statement on Freshwater Management 2011, and the Waitakere Ranges Heritage Area Act 2008. 3. GENERAL COMMENTS. EDS supports the intention of the Draft Plan to deliver the vision for Auckland set out in the Auckland Plan but raises concerns regarding the loss of local planning detail, drafting errors, lack of non-regulatory methods, and document length. 4. CONTENT. Detailed feedback and recommendations are provided across multiple environmental domains including Urban Form, Freshwater, Biodiversity, Rural Development, Landscape and Natural Character, Coastal, and Marine environments, followed by specific comments on the Regional Policy Statement, Objectives, Policies, and Rules.
